downloadable_stories.title: The Wrong Address
downloadable_stories.author: Olivia Blackwood
downloadable_stories.description: A forgotten letter. A name from the past. As Mia begins searching for answers, she discovers that some places never truly let go of their secrets.

downloadable_stories.title: Sunday Soup
downloadable_stories.author: Clara Whitmore
downloadable_stories.description: Every Sunday, Oscar makes soup alone in his small kitchen — the same soup, the same way his wife taught him. One Sunday, his new neighbor knocks to borrow salt. She stays for the whole afternoon.

downloadable_stories.title: The Night Shift
downloadable_stories.author: James Ashford
downloadable_stories.description: Nora has worked the overnight shift at the hospital for ten years. She knows how to read the quiet. But the patient in room 14 — with no name on his chart — is a kind of quiet she has never encountered before.

downloadable_stories.title: Salt and Sea
downloadable_stories.author: Isla Chen
downloadable_stories.description: Marco is sixteen when his parents separate and he is sent to spend the summer on a Greek island with his grandmother. He brings his anger with him. The island is patient.

downloadable_stories.title: The Translator
downloadable_stories.author: Maren Holst
downloadable_stories.description: Yuki works as a simultaneous interpreter at an international conference in Brussels. By the third day, she realizes that what she is hearing in Japanese does not match what the official documents say — and that she is the only person in the room who knows.

downloadable_stories.title: Footprints in the Snow
downloadable_stories.author: Elara Vance
downloadable_stories.description: A mountain village wakes to find a set of footprints in the fresh snow — leading into the forest and stopping completely in the middle of nowhere. Ruth follows them. What she finds changes everything she thought she knew.

downloadable_stories.title: The Inheritance
downloadable_stories.author: Jean-Pierre Pingoc
downloadable_stories.description: Clara has met her grandmother five times in her life. When the woman dies, she leaves Clara a house in a village Clara has never visited. Inside the house, on the kitchen table, there is a list — and at the bottom, one word: bakery.

downloadable_stories.title: The Repair Shop
downloadable_stories.author: Ben Okoro
downloadable_stories.description: Han fixes things. Chairs, clocks, cameras — everything broken in the small town of Fern eventually arrives at his workbench. One afternoon, a woman brings a music box that plays a song nobody can name.

downloadable_stories.title: Red Line
downloadable_stories.author: A. Kovar
downloadable_stories.description: Every morning, Daniel rides the same metro line to work. Every morning, the same man in a grey coat stands near the second door of Car 3. One morning, the man is not there. Three minutes later, Daniel's phone buzzes with a message from an unknown number: Get off at the next stop.
